description: React component for a modal dialog that allows adding groups to a channel in Mattermost. It manages group selection, search, pagination, and linking groups to channels.

classes.name: AddGroupsToChannelModal
classes.description: React component class for managing the modal dialog to add groups to a channel, including search, pagination, and linking logic.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches initial data: team info, associated groups, and non-associated groups when component mounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles search term changes with debounce to fetch filtered groups.

methods.name: handleHide
methods.description: Hides the modal and resets search term.

methods.name: handleResponse
methods.description: Handles server response errors during group linking.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Submits selected groups to be added to the channel, linking them via API calls.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a selected group to the current selection.

methods.name: setGroupsLoadingState
methods.description: Sets loading state for group data.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Removes selected groups from the current selection.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Updates the search term for filtering groups.

methods.name: renderOption
methods.description: Renders a group option in the multiselect dropdown.

methods.name: renderValue
methods.description: Renders the display value for a selected group.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the modal dialog with group selection UI.
